answer: A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Histories are stored in trellis, checked in lantern, and willow makes public each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 15 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. The per-identity price is 107 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
